rows.text: At 17:05 on 28 May 1996 the Speaker referred to the resignation announced by the Prime Minister on the floor of the House, held that putting the Motion of Confidence to the vote had become infructuous and adjourned the House sine die (17:06).
The Speaker ruled on 28 May 1996 that, in view of the announced resignation, the Motion of Confidence moved by Vajpayee would not be put to the vote; no division took place.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only.
